ModMetaData.name: Crop Cold Tolerance Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Separates crop growth limits from fixed cold-death thresholds.
Crop Cold Tolerance Overhaul can also be used as a lightweight framework by other mods. Dependent mods can define or override plant cold-death temperatures and cold dormancy through XML without replacing the plant class.
